combats.encounter: Ghost strangling Hralgar in the dream palace

entries.summary: Runs up the cliff and leaps beside the ghost. His first staff attack misses on 14; the second hits on 23 for 11 damage. A bonus unarmed strike also hits, with no damage stated. Soul Sight is deferred because the bonus action was already used.
Moves and Misty Steps beside the ghost, then hits it twice. Character-sheet errors are corrected to 12 and 19 damage; the second attack’s corrected 16 hits.

Directs a lightning strike at Riswynn, Seeker and Wellby between Delwath’s and Seeker’s turns. Riswynn and Seeker take 46 lightning damage each, dropping Riswynn; Wellby succeeds on the Dexterity save and takes 23.

Casts fourth-level Healing Word, restoring Riswynn to 19 hit points, then animates the ladder instead of casting another leveled spell or using Shocking Grasp. Animation requires no concentration here.

Uses Steady Aim and rolls two d20s, scoring a critical arrow hit. The table retrospectively includes the usual maximum bowstring charges, adding 8d6 fire damage; the final accepted total is 72 damage to the ghost.
Flies beside Riswynn so she can board it; carrying her to the giant is deferred to its next turn.
Squeezes Hralgar’s heart again for a significant unstated amount of damage, leaving him badly hurt, then hits Delwath with its other hand for about 33 bludgeoning damage.
Casts fifth-level Guiding Bolt at the ghost, apparently missing, and boards the animated ladder instead of climbing a rope.
entries.note: Riswynn asks whether it misses and Seeker says “No, No”; no clear DM hit or damage resolution follows, so the attack result remains qualified.

entries.summary: Soul Sight reveals highest Strength and lowest Dexterity/Charisma. Two staff hits deal 10 and 8 damage: the first Disrupting Strike is resisted with a 19 Charisma save; the second fails DC 15 on 14, subtracting 1d4 from attacks and preventing reactions. Flurry attacks hit for 10 and 7 damage. A Stunning Strike is resisted with a 25 Constitution save; he spends ki on another after the final hit, without a stated save result.

Casts Sanctuary on the non-attacking Hralgar, requiring a Wisdom save before hostile attacks or harmful effects against him. Delwath then critically hits the ghost for 27 damage and hits again for 18.
At the end of Delwath’s turn, makes a lightning spell attack against him with the Disrupting Strike’s minus 1d4. The resulting 20 hits AC 20 and deals 26 lightning damage.
entries.note: The source establishes an off-turn attack but does not name a legendary action or reaction; it is retained as an event.

entries.summary: Casts fifth-level Erupting Earth in a cube placed to hit only the ghost. It fails its Dexterity save with 7 and takes the full 17 damage.
Cannot reach the ghost with its corrected 30-foot movement, so dashes instead of attacking, carrying Riswynn the roughly 40 feet and placing her beside the giant.
entries.note: Riswynn says she did not want that, but no revised placement is resolved before combat ends.

entries.summary: Uses Steady Aim, rolls two d20s and scores a second critical arrow hit, this time without another Burning Strike. The damage is corrected from 44 to 49; the ghost fades and Hralgar can breathe and rise, but remains blind.

ending.summary: Wellby’s second critical arrow makes the ghost fade away. Hralgar rises and breathes freely but is still blind; the statue’s later destruction is outside initiative.
